title: Almond Delight
description: A hearty, savory casserole of browned breakfast sausage, wild rice, and toasted slivered almonds baked together with vegetables and chicken noodle soup mix for incredible depth of flavor. Cozy, crowd-pleasing, and surprisingly elegant.
ingredients: 2 lbs ground breakfast sausage (Jimmy Dean recommended)
2 celery stalks, finely diced or sliced (optional)
2 packages dry chicken noodle soup mix
0.5 cup white rice (or 1.5 cups white rice if not using wild rice)
4 cups broth (chicken or vegetable broth recommended; water acceptable)

title: Bacon-Apple-Jalapeño Pop 'Ems
description: Crispy bacon-wrapped jalapeño halves stuffed with a creamy apple-scallion filling — the ultimate crowd-pleasing party bite that balances heat, tang, and smoky richness in every pop.
ingredients: 1 (8-ounce) package light cream cheese, at room temperature
1 large Granny Smith apple, cored and minced
3 large scallions, roots removed, green and white parts finely minced
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
20 strips thin-sliced bacon, cut in half

title: Banana Chocolate Chip Bars
description: Banana bread's snackable cousin: soft, sweet, and loaded with chocolate chips in every bite.

title: Barbecue (Ice Cream Social)
description: A Midwestern church-cookbook sloppy joe — tangy tomato soup, ketchup, onion, celery, and a splash of Worcestershire.

title: Basic Vanilla Pudding
description: Creamy, old-fashioned stovetop pudding made from scratch. Top it however you like.

title: Blueberry Muffins
description: Tender, sweet, and loaded with juicy berries. Topped with sparkly coarse sugar for that bakery-window magic.

title: Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Light, fluffy, and ridiculously easy. The kind of pancakes that make weekday mornings feel like a lazy Sunday.
ingredients: Butter and maple syrup, as desired

title: Championship Bean Dip
description: A rich, cheesy slow-cooker bean dip loaded with refried beans, two melted cheeses, and a kick of chili spice — the ultimate crowd-pleasing party appetizer.
ingredients: 1 cup (4 oz) shredded Monterey Jack cheese

title: Chicken Breast Casserole
description: A comforting, weeknight-friendly casserole layered with tender chicken breasts, creamy mushroom sauce, and a golden, herb-seasoned stuffing crust that bakes up perfectly in under an hour.
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 6 oz each)
1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
1 package (6 oz) Stove Top stuffing mix (chicken flavor)
1/4 cup milk, approximately, adjusting as needed to moisten stuffing

title: Chicken Broccoli Rice Casserole
description: Cheesy one-pot comfort with tender chicken, broccoli, and rice, all topped with a buttery Ritz cracker crunch.
ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts or 2 cups diced rotisserie chicken
1¼ cups white long grain rice, uncooked
10.5 oz condensed cream of chicken soup

title: Chocolate Zucchini Bread
description: Moist, fudgy double chocolate bread hiding a whole zucchini in every loaf. No one will believe there's a vegetable in this.
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, spooned and leveled
1/2 cup unsweetened natural cocoa powder (not Dutch process)
1 1/2 cups shredded zucchini (no need to blot)

title: Delicious Ham and Potato Soup
description: A cozy, creamy comfort bowl that comes together in under an hour.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground white or black pepper

title: Double Chocolate Cookies
description: Rich, fudgy cookies loaded with semisweet chips and dark chocolate chunks. A hit of espresso makes the chocolate sing.

title: French Boulangerie-Style Pizza
description: Crème fraîche stands in for tomato sauce, Gruyère melts into a soft focaccia-like crust — the kind of pizza you'd grab from a French neighborhood bakery.

title: Glazed Meatballs
description: Tender meatballs simmered in a sweet-and-tangy chili-grape glaze that caramelizes into an irresistible sticky coating. A beloved party classic that comes together with just three ingredients.

title: Gochujang Chicken
description: Crispy air fryer chicken thighs with a sweet-spicy gochujang glaze that caramelizes into something dangerously good.
ingredients: 4 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs, patted dry

title: Jamie's Minestrone Soup
description: A hearty, vegetable-loaded Italian soup that gets better the longer it simmers.
ingredients: 2 cups fresh or frozen green beans, cut into 1½-inch pieces
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese, for topping

title: Kathy's Meatloaf
description: Old-school comfort meatloaf held together with oatmeal, crushed saltines, and a packet of onion soup mix.
ingredients: Lawry's seasoning salt, a few shakes (optional)

title: Key Lime Pie
description: Tangy, creamy, and almost too easy — a no-fuss custard pie that tastes like a tropical getaway in a graham crust.
ingredients: 1 Keebler Ready Crust graham pie crust, 10-inch
2 cans sweetened condensed milk, 14 oz each

title: LaBonte Chili
description: A no-fuss family chili with two kinds of kidney beans and a kick from Lipton onion soup mix.
ingredients: 2 cans (14.5 oz each) stewed or crushed tomatoes

title: Mac & Cheese Crockpot Magic
description: Creamy, three-cheese comfort straight from the slow cooker — tender pasta and melted cheese with almost zero fuss.
ingredients: 3 cups shredded Gruyère or Parmesan cheese
1½ tsp ground mustard (optional, for extra flavor)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
Fresh parsley or chives, for garnish (optional)

title: Mapo Tofu
description: The real-deal Sichuan classic — spicy, tongue-numbing, and absolutely not optional without rice.
ingredients: 1–2 fresh Thai bird chili peppers, thinly sliced
½–1½ tablespoons Sichuan peppercorns, ground (reserve ¼ tsp for garnish)
1 lb silken tofu, cut into 1-inch cubes

title: Maria's Pepper Steak
description: A sweet and savory stir-fry with tender flank steak, bell peppers, and a honey-soy glaze that's hard to mess up.
ingredients: 2 large bell peppers, sliced into thin strips
1½ pounds flank steak, cut into thin strips

title: Mom's BBQ Beans
description: A sweet and smoky baked bean casserole with a rich, caramelized glaze that's the perfect crowd-pleasing side dish for any cookout or family gathering.
ingredients: 3 cans (15 oz each) Campbell's Pork and Beans

title: Mom's Chili
description: A hearty, slow-cooked family chili packed with kidney beans, savory ground beef, and zesty pepperoni that deepens in flavor the longer it simmers.
ingredients: 1 very large can (28 oz) kidney beans, drained
1 very large can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 very large can (28 oz) tomato sauce
1 package (1.25 oz) Old El Paso or McCormick chili seasoning mix

title: Mom's Lasagna
description: A hearty, comforting classic layered with tender noodles, creamy cottage cheese, rich tomato sauce, and melted mozzarella — just like Grandma used to make.
ingredients: 1 1/2 large cans garlic herb spaghetti sauce
2 packages (16 oz each) shredded mozzarella cheese

title: Nana's Fish Chowder
description: A soul-warming, old-fashioned New England-style fish chowder with tender cod, buttery potatoes, and a rich, creamy milk broth — simple comfort food at its finest.
ingredients: 1 cup butter, divided (half for cooking, half added at the end)
2 cans (15 oz each) diced potatoes, drained
2 cups water, approximately, or enough to cover the onion and potatoes
3 cups whole milk, approximately, or enough to cover after the fish cooks
Salt and pepper, to taste — approximately ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper

title: Pailin's Authentic Pad Thai
description: The real-deal Thai street food classic with tamarind, palm sugar, and all the proper bits.
ingredients: 3 oz pressed tofu, cut into small pieces
3 tablespoons sweet preserved daikon radish, chopped
35 g palm sugar, chopped (about 3 tablespoons tightly packed)
4 oz dry rice noodles, medium width, soaked in room-temperature water for 1 hour
7–10 stalks garlic chives, cut into 2-inch pieces
¼ cup roasted peanuts, roughly crushed

title: Peanut Butter Balls
description: Four ingredients, no oven, and dangerously easy to make. Crunchy, sweet, and packed with peanut butter.

title: Quick Pickled Red Onions
description: Tangy, slightly sweet, and spiced with cinnamon and oregano. Put them on everything.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A simple, comforting shortcut soup for when you don't have time to make it from scratch.
ingredients: Salt and ground black pepper to taste

title: Rotel Tomato Cheese Dip
description: The ultimate two-ingredient queso dip — creamy, velvety Velveeta melted together with zesty Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chiles for a crowd-pleasing snack that comes together in minutes.
ingredients: 1 can (10 oz) Ro-Tel Original Diced Tomatoes with Green Chiles, drained
1 medium package (16 oz) Velveeta cheese, cubed

title: Speedy Taco Bake
description: A beefy, cheesy taco casserole with a Bisquick crust that bakes up golden in 35 minutes.

title: Uncle Larry's Cheese Bread Beer Dip
description: A crowd-pleasing party classic featuring a creamy, beer-spiked cheese dip poured into a hollowed-out rye bread bowl, surrounded by chunks of soft bread for dipping.

title: White Chocolate Cranberry Oatmeal Cookies
description: Chewy, hearty oatmeal cookies loaded with sweet white chocolate chips and tangy dried cranberries, warmly spiced with cinnamon and kissed with vanilla.
